Equation 11:
\mu=\mu_{max}\frac{S}{K_{s}+S}\exp\left(-\frac{S}{K_{I}}\right)

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  \mu  ->  mu   (Specific bacteria growth rate)
  S  ->  S_   (Substrate concentration)
  K_{I}  ->  KI   (Inhibition constant in the Aiba-Edwards growth law.)
  K_{s}  ->  Ks   (Half saturation constant)
  \mu_{max}  ->  mumax   (Maximum specific growth rate)
